posts.title: Modern Overlay Protocols: VXLAN & Geneve
posts.description: Modern multi-tenant data centres and cloud infrastructures present network challenges that traditional Layer 2 technologies were never designed to handle. Today’s networks must provide a large number of isolated, segregated networks that nevertheless share parts of the infrastructure (e.g., Internet access, storage environments).
